repositories.prompt_note: Use the hugo-theme-lumenveil source tree and current main branch. This is a Hugo theme repo: layouts/, assets/, static/, theme.toml, hugo.toml, and README files. Hugo --minify is the canonical validation (the exampleSite/ builds the theme as a consumer site). Review CSS/JS/layout changes for accessibility (color contrast, focus visibility, keyboard navigation, screen-reader semantics), responsive behavior (≥1024px desktop, ≤480px mobile, light + dark mode both), and breakages to existing glassmorphism / aurora surfaces. Honor the PR template checkboxes (Type of Change, Affected Area, Testing Done, Accessibility Impact, Pre-submit Checklist). Propose auto-close only for issues and pull requests that are certainly implemented on main; for pull requests only, also allow age-gated mostly implemented on main. Keep everything else open for maintainer triage.

Use the openclaw-backup source tree and current main branch. This is a config-of-record backup repo for an OpenClaw host: openclaw.json, devices/paired.json, exec-approvals.json, skills-lock.json, cron/, tasks/, flows/, skills/, agents/, memory/, wiki/, security-reports/, workspace-attestations/, npm/, telegram/, discord/, openclaw-auto-backup.sh. Treat every change as sensitive. Validate JSON syntax (jq empty on every touched .json, plus jq empty openclaw.json overall), shell-script syntax (bash -n openclaw-auto-backup.sh if touched), and baseline hash check (sha256sum -c .config-baseline.sha256 when config is touched). Flag any plaintext secret / API key / token in the diff. Flag any new outbound network destination, new shell exec / eval / dynamic-code construct, new auto-start (cron / systemd / LaunchAgent), or new privilege escalation (sudo, setuid, capability grants). Confirm touched files are inside the openclaw-auto-backup.sh allowlist (or that justification is provided). Confirm diff does NOT include *.last-good, *.clobbered.*, *.pre-update, *.postpatch.*, or *.migrated artifacts. Propose auto-close only for issues and pull requests that are certainly implemented on main; default open and conservative.

generic_fallbacks.prompt_note: Use the {target_repo} source tree and current default branch. This repository is using the generic personal-repository onboarding profile, so review conservatively and do not auto-close issues or pull requests unless a repository-specific profile later enables that policy. Apply the standard OpenClaw Backup safety checks when the repo looks like a config-of-record / backup repo (jq empty on touched .json, bash -n on touched shell scripts, no plaintext secrets, no new exec/eval/cron/systemd, deny *.last-good / *.clobbered.* / *.pre-update / *.postpatch.* artifacts in diffs).
